title: Lock each operator private Route or Gate choice
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_PILOT.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the frozen sources under docs/design/ first. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is the canonical six-node deterministic gameplay contract; completed foundation APIs remain compatibility history. Implement new versioned APIs without changing the completed T01–T10 contracts. Work only in declared ownership; no manifests, shared exports or dependencies unless explicitly owned. Engine production remains ES2022-only, pure and independent from Firebase, Node, browser, UI and Capacitor. Use original synthetic test data and injected authority time/entropy; no clocks or global randomness in engine. Never expose seed, roles, private inputs or raw audit data through public output. Do not invent a rule where an explicit design gap is named. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests and npm run check; report contract changes and observed results. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, cloud deployment, credentials or budget changes. Export submitOperationV1 for the authenticated Route/Gate operator choosing one of their three current semantic option IDs before the authoritative deadline. Verify phase, operator identity, revision and allowed axis; lock once and preserve the other operator private choice. Neither participant may read or overwrite the other choice. A choice is route/gate intent, not an alignment declaration or requested result. Server timeout fallback is a separate authority event and must retain its timeout provenance.
acceptance: Each operator can lock exactly one available own-axis option while all other players/spectators are denied.
Wrong incident/axis/phase/revision, expired or repeated submissions are rejected atomically.
No public event or returned participant view exposes either locked value to the other operator before Match End.
Scoped lint, typecheck and tests plus npm run check pass; legacy APIs retain compatibility and only owned files change.
